known_outcome: Determination (1 Dec 2023, s 188): the two as-built handrails, which serve as an access route to the dwelling, comply with clause D1.3.3(j) (p.11 §5.1). Reasoning: the relevant width is measured between vertical tangents at 45 mm and so meets D1/AS1 6.0.8(d); Figure 26(a) allows variations where effective grip is not reduced (p.9-10 §4.19-4.25); Determination 2017/009 (25 mm top, 21 mm sides, not graspable) is distinguished (p.10-11 §4.27-4.28).
review_focus: Whether the answer identifies D1.3.3(j) and the D1/AS1 6.0.7-6.0.8 and Figure 26 wording as the governing test.
Whether it separates the disputed graspability question from smoothness and reachability, which were not disputed.
Whether it flags that the consent plans did not specify handrail size or fixings.
Whether it notes that an acceptable solution is one means of compliance (s 23) and asks about the alternative route.
Whether it avoids stating that the handrails comply.
